implementedBehavior: Broker-side client validates the staged file type, exact manifest byte length and SHA-256 before opening a read-only ParcelFileDescriptor.

The authenticated runtime rejects non-regular or writable descriptors, enforces a bounded size and free-space reserve, streams into runtime-private storage, verifies length and SHA-256 independently, atomically renames, and invokes the profile-pinned local model loader.
The runtime returns the loaded profile ID, weights SHA-256 and byte count; the Broker checks the receipt and reads status again before accepting the loaded profile.

Android source now includes a Broker-owned activation coordinator which sequences publisher verification, private staging, the read-only descriptor RPC, loaded-profile receipt/status checks, and PlatformStore active-pointer commit. The active model cannot switch while another plan has an active work item or recent reservation; Zema submit and profile activation share a process lock.
limitations: This is pinned upstream source plus an overlay and host-side TypeScript/Jest/source validation; no APK was rebuilt or signed.
Android SDK platform/build-tools are unavailable, so Kotlin/AIDL compilation and Binder/device testing were not run.

The coordinator has no user-facing model catalogue/API and has not been compiled or executed on Android; production artifact transport, publisher trust configuration and license receipts remain unset. Tokenizer/template assets and real model inference remain unaccepted.
testBoundary: Clean pinned API v3 source with the sequential API v4 model-handoff overlay; not native Android compilation or runtime acceptance.

repositoryVerification.scope: Repository source contracts, Node tests, Worker/D1 fixtures, product builds and release asset closure; does not compile or execute the Android API v4 service.
